en: ...Valka, what you just said...

Indeed. What I have just
described is the mother star of
Sir Ewin, Lady Welch, and Lady
Carlin,
Daftine, and the general state\nof the universe.
That's a bit...
I can't believe it, but...

<font color=blue>Valka</font> The Rubarika Kingdom
and Baschen Empire are both
nations on the massive Planet
Daftine.
And Planet Daftine floats\nwithin a vast sea of stars.
This Daftes is the twin star of\nDaftine. They are a binary\nplanet system.
<font color=blue>Euwin</font> ...Did Eve and the others\nknow?
<font color=blue>Eve</font> ...Yes.
<font color=blue>Verda</font> Forgive us... It wasn't\nthat we were hiding it out of\nmalice...

<font color=blue>Euwin</font> True, just as the Captain
said; if you'd told us that so
suddenly, we wouldn't have
believed you either...
In truth, even now, they don't\nbelieve it much.
<font color=blue>Valka</font> If my memory serves me,\nin Mista... no, in Captain\n<player>'s home world,
No, if I am to follow your\nintroduction, perhaps I should\ncall you Sir Lakstar?
Euwin is fine. To me, a noble\nfamily name is nothing more\nthan a tool.

We have the safety and time
to process the truth here.
There are signs of injury and
exhaustion, too. For a while,
stay here...
...Ugh.
Lady Welch? Is something...
...I knew it.
...Lady Welch... I know you're in\nshock, but...
Ugh... You've gotta be kidding\nmeeeee!!
Oof!?

Whoa, what is that!? Not just
Rubarika, but the whole world
of Daftine is floating in this
massive space!?
Whoa!! Eve, Verda, and even\nthe Captain came from beyond\nthe stars!?
And now you're saying Tika\nmight have come from the\nfuture!?
What is all this!? This is getting\nme so hyped up!
Lady Welch: ...Ugh.
...Lady Welch... she must be in\nshock...
Lady Welch: Ugh... You've gotta\nbe kidding meeeee!!

Whoa, what is this?! Not just
Rubarika, but the entire world
of Daftine is floating in a
massive space?!
Whoa!! Eve, Verda, and even\nthe Captain came from beyond\nthe stars?!
And Tika might even be from\nthe future?!

Lady Welch: What is that?!
What is that?! What is that?!
I'm getting so pumped up right
now!
Lady Welch: Hey! You're Valka,\nright?!
Y-yes.

Lady Welch: Since you know
about that, you came from
beyond the sky too, didn't
you?!

Lady Welch: You came from
outer space, right?! I mean,
this place is already beyond
the sky, isn't it?!
B-beyond the sky? W-well, that\nis correct...
Lady Welch... Um, could you\nplease step back a little?
Lady Welch: No way! Let me\nsee more!
Huh?!
Lady Welch: This ship! And\nyour weapons?! And your\nbody?!
Wh-What!?
Let's see, this part goes here,\nand that part goes there...
Wait, stop! Lady Welch!
And then, I'll just try pressing\nthis button~.
Ah, not there! No!
Here we go again.
I wonder if Valka is going to be\nokay...
...Raising alert level for Welch\nVineyard...
However, diagnosis indicates\nthis state is normal... Error\nimminent...
Everything I'm looking at, where\nI'm standing, everything I'm\ntouching!
It's all things I would have\nstaked my life to obtain!

Tell me more, tell me
everything, and if possible, let
me examine every inch of your
bodyyyyy!
I-I said no! Hey! St-Stop it...!!
Hmph!
Ow...
Ugh... i-it's nothing... l-let me\nexamine...
Give it a rest!!
What was that?
Welch, hold on a second. I'll\ntake all your questions at once\nlater.
Right now, there are more\nimportant things I need to ask,\nso leave it for later.
Aaanh! Hurry up already!! My\ncuriosity is gonna make me\nexplode!!
I'm sure Euwin and Karlyn are\nconfused, but this situation is\nfull of mysteries for us, too.
Would you mind if I spoke with\nher first?

Go ahead. I want to organize
the situation a bit, and if we let
Welch do whatever she wants,
we'll never make any progress.
...Do as you wish. It's not like I'll\nunderstand anything even if I\nlisten.
...I'm going to go get some\nfresh air.
My head hurts because of\nsomeone who's both loud and\ncompletely oblivious.
Haaaah!? What's with that\nattitude?!
Welch. Right now, Karlyn is the\none most confused by this\nsituation.
Leave her be.
Huh!? She's not the sensitive\ntype...
She's all alone.
Eh?
Karlyn is all alone right now.
Hey, Captain. Can I go take a\nlook at the view outside for a\nbit, too?
...Okay! I'm off!
<font color=blue>Rekoro</font> Tika! Wait, me too...!
<font color=blue>Rekoro</font> Captain! Why are you\nstopping me?!
<font color=blue>Eve</font> Hey, Captain, are you\nokay? Letting Tika go out by\nherself...
<font color=blue>Valka</font> There are no dangerous\ncreatures in the vicinity.

It appears Lady Carlin was a
soldier belonging to your
enemy forces, yet she has left
her weapon lying there.
When I spoke to her, I\nobserved significant agitation\nin her heart rate and pulse.
The possibility of her harming\nLady Tika is extremely low.
<font color=blue>Rekoro</font> But...
<font color=blue>Valka</font> AI Rekoro. I judge Lady\nTika is trying to empathize with\nLady Carlin's sudden loneliness.
This is an opportunity for Lady\nTika's mental growth.

If Lady Carlin's movements
cause you anxiety, I shall link
AI Rekoro's sensors with my
ship's sensors.
You may then use that to\nmonitor the two of them.
Lady Leash, would that be\nacceptable to you as well?
<font color=blue>Rekoro</font> ...Please do.
<font color=blue>Valka</font> ...Link complete.
<font color=blue>Eve</font> That's incredible\ntechnology. Your body and the\nship are linked, aren't they?
<font color=blue>Eve</font> Well then, getting to the\nmain point... what exactly are\nyou doing here on Daftes?

<font color=blue>Verda</font>, even ignoring your
origins on the advanced planet
EnII, you grasp Daftine's
situation remarkably quickly.

Between your sensors and this
ship's equipment, you've been
monitoring Daftine. What is
your purpose?
<font color=blue>Valka</font> ...Let me make one thing\nclear first.
Neither I nor <font color=yellow>EnII</font> harbor any\nmalice or intent to harm either\nthe planet Daftine or Daftes.
Originally, I was supposed to\ndescend upon <font color=yellow>Mastima</font>.
<font color=blue>Eve</font> Mastima...? A satellite...\nyou mean a moon?
<font color=blue>Valka</font> Precisely. Mastima is the\nmoon of the planet Daftine.

On Daftine, it is known as the
entity that lowered the
Moonshadow Ladder, linking
Daftes, the moon, and Daftine
after the Holy Land War.

And unraveling the mystery of
that Moonshadow Ladder was
the primary reason I was
dispatched to this sector.
...Should I start by making you\ndisappear?

The most gifted Summon Crest
adapter... how tragic... If only
Evelysse hadn't appeared, you
might have been the Gate.
But a counterfeit can never\nhope to reach the level of the\nreal thing.
You have worked hard in your\ndevotion. Now, you may rest...
...What... was it all for...?
Ah...
It's you...
What do you want?
I-I'm sorry... I was just a little\nworried.
Worried? You? About me? Is\nthis some kind of joke?
Hieee...!
U-Um...
...Tika, was it?
Y-Yes... I'm Tika Blanche.
Why the sudden formality?

U-Um, since I've been hiding
things about space until now, I
thought I should properly
introduce myself again, and
so...
...I'm sorry.
...Ahaha.
Eh?
You... you're a child of privilege,\naren't you?
Huh?
I've seen girls like you\noccasionally at Baschen's\nImperial Castle.

Children with wonderful
personalities, a good education,
wealth, and families who love
them...
U-Um... You mean I'm like a\nnoble child from Baschen,\nright?
I'm just a girl from a normal\nfamily.
Even though Ricardo Franz has\nput a 100,000 bounty on your\nhead using his own name?
I'm not from this era. I came\nfrom the future, from Daftine.
That's why I don't understand\nwhy General Ricardo is looking\nfor me.
...The future.
...Tika.
Yes?
To me... the "future" is\nsomething I don't quite\nunderstand.
Huh?
Born as a Fox Soul... becoming\na soldier... fighting in the Holy\nLand War...
I've always left everything\nbeyond tomorrow to the hands\nof others.
Are you saying... you come\nfrom far beyond tomorrow? Do\nyou know what lies ahead?

Eh? Beyond tomorrow? U-um,
it's not like I'm a
super-powered person or a
prophet or anything...
They didn't teach us about\nthat in school, so I don't know\nthe details at all, so, um...
Hehe, don't panic. There is only\none thing I want to know.
I-I don't know if I'll know, but if\nit's something I can answer...
Beyond tomorrow... in the\nDaftine where you lived...
I wonder if the Fox Spirit\npeople are living in peace?
That's...
Or... I wonder if the word "Fox\nSpirit" even exists anymore.

To guide the galaxy toward a
righteous future for the sake
of life's survival. That is the
mission of us Morphus.
My arrival in this sector was\nalso on the orders of the <font color=yellow>Ex</font>\nthat oversees EnII.
It has been about one year\nsince I drifted ashore on this\nDaftes.
Since a year ago? By yourself?
That is correct. As an\nobservation period, it is by no\nmeans long.

In particular, details on the
Holy Land War of Daftine
cannot be gathered while
staying on Daftes.
I would very much like to\nconduct an interview with Sir\nEwin and Lady Welch later.
Of course, of course! Ask me\nanything, ask me anything!!
In exchange, though, I'd love it\nif you could tell me all sorts of\nthings about youuuu~.
Welch!! Wait! I'll talk. I'll talk!!
I know way, way more about\nthe reality of the Holy Land\nWar than you do.
So, stay away from her.
Whaaaaaat!? Whyyyy!!
I have plenty to say to you, but\nif you get involved, we'll never\nmake any progress.

Captain, Eve, Verda. Please
proceed with the necessary
discussions! I'll hold things
down here!!
Aaaah, Euwin, you're so mean!!
Hang in there a little longer,\nEuwin!
He truly is an indispensable\nman for our journey...
<font color=blue>Verda</font> Ahem. Er, sorry about\nthat,
Well, I heard you are observing\nDaftine and Daftes...
Didn't you just say you were\ngoing to land on the satellite\nMastima?
<font color=blue>Valka</font> ...Yes.
<font color=blue>Verda</font> Then why are you on\nDaftes?
<font color=blue>Valka</font> ...It is a pathetic story.
...I was shot down.
<font color=blue>Eve</font> Shot down!?
<font color=blue>Verda</font> What on earth do you\nmean by that!?
<font color=blue>Valka</font> To be honest, I don't\nknow myself.

I scrutinized the ship's data,
but found no footage or trace
of the one who shot down my
vessel.
There is no doubt, however,\nthat it was an attack by the\nAdvanced Planet Force.
<font color=blue>Eve</font> An attack by the\nAdvanced Planet Force from\nout of nowhere...
...Does that mean...
<font color=blue>Verda</font> Hmm... It is extremely\nsimilar to the situation the\nLevarance fleet fell into.

<font color=blue>Valka</font> and the ship's AI were
scanning both planets'
civilization levels via long-range
sensors.
we were completely\ndefenseless against the threat\nof an attack.

The Hardier Warrior of
Morphus travels across vast
galactic distances in cold
sleep.

The fact that the ship's
sensors maintained my cold
sleep should give you an idea
of just how safe it was.
<font color=blue>Verda</font> You were navigating\nspace alone while in cold\nsleep!?

<font color=blue>Valka</font> It is not unusual for a
Hardier Warrior of Morphus,
and cold sleep is a common
practice on EnII.
<font color=blue>Verda</font> That is a complete\nchange of subject... I see.

Setting that aside, when we
arrived in this sector, there
should not have been anything
resembling that anywhere...
<font color=blue>Eve</font> Attacking so many ships\nwithout even being visible...
It's just like a ghost ship from\na horror story.
<font color=blue>Verda</font> A ghost ship? What are\nyou talking about, Eve? Such a\nthing is...
<font color=blue>Valka</font> It is not impossible.
<font color=blue>Verda</font> What do you mean?
<font color=blue>Valka</font> Once, there existed an\narmy of wraiths that plunged\nthe entire universe into terror.
<font color=blue>Eve</font> An army of wraiths...
<font color=blue>Valka</font> There is no such thing\nas "common sense" in this\nuniverse.
There is only the accumulation\nof facts as they occur in the\nmoment.
Invisible ghost starships... such\nthings might very well exist.
<font color=blue>Eve</font> Come to think of it, that\nmigrant ship Tika was on...
<font color=blue>Verda</font> Rekoro did say she\ndidn't see the appearance of\nthe attackers...
It can't be.
Wait a second. This\nconversation is heading in a\nweird direction.
Euwin?

Assessing the situation is key,
but this talk of a "ghost"
"starship" isn't something we
need to solve right this second.
...No, it's not that I've fully\ngrasped the whole "space"\nthing yet.
But I do know that isn't the\nmost important thing right now.

From what we know, everyone
here is in a place they
shouldn't be due to an
unforeseen incident.

Me, Welch, and Karlyn are on
Daftine. Tika is from the future.
The Captain and the others
arrived here on a ship.
Even you, Valka, your original\ndestination wasn't here, right?
That is correct.
In that case, shouldn't we first\nlook for a way to return to our\noriginal locations?

We should wait until we've
established a way to travel
before worrying about how to
deal with that invisible ghost
ship.
Discussing its true nature right\nnow... would just be a waste of\ntime that'll leave us hungry.
<font color=blue>Euwin</font>: Let's go through this\nstep by step.

Is it safe to assume that
"space" is the sea, "planets"
are islands or continents, and
"spacecraft" are ships?
<font color=blue>Verda</font>: Y-yes. That\nunderstanding is correct.

<font color=blue>Euwin</font>: Valka, the Captain,
Karlyn, and us being on Daftes
right now was unplanned.
Right?
<font color=blue>Valka</font>: That is correct.
<font color=blue>Euwin</font>: What we are looking for\nis not on this Daftes.
In that case, what we must do\nnow is first secure a ship that\ncan cross the sea.
If we are going to discuss\nthings, let's focus on that.

<font color=blue>Euwin</font>: Given Valka has lived
here for a year since her ship
was destroyed, the ghost ship
won't be landing on Daftes.

Therefore, we can't devise
countermeasures until we
decide what to load onto the
prepared ship.
So, I want to ask. Captain,\nValka. Can you prepare a ship?
<font color=blue>Verda</font>: ...Our ship is in orbit\naround Daftine.
Considering the distance to\nDaftes, it isn't that far, but...
Captain, Rekoro. Has\ncommunication with Coro been\nrestored?
<font color=blue>Rekoro</font> ...It is the same as the\nCaptain. Communication with\nCoro has not been restored.

<font color=blue>Eve</font> What about distress
signals? Rekoro, try sending
your distress signal toward
Coro...

<font color=blue>Rekoro</font> My wide-area signal
transmission function depends
on the transmission function of
the lifeboat itself.

The communication functions in
this body aren't designed for
distances beyond a planetary
surface and its orbit.
<font color=blue>Euwin</font> In other words, you can't\nprepare it.
<font color=blue>Verda</font> As for Valka's ship,\nnaturally...
<font color=blue>Valka</font> is too damaged from\nbeing shot down and crashing\nto withstand space travel.
How is the communication? Is\nthe communication function on\nValka's ship...?
It is damaged. The only things\nstill functioning are life support\nand observation.
Therefore... in truth, we cannot\neven send out a distress\nsignal...
...I had given up.
Hmm?
I was lonely.
What?
I thought... *sniff*... that\nmaybe... *hic*... no one... would\never... find me...
I thought I was going to have\nto live on this planet all by\nmyself... forever.
H-Hold on a second...
WAAAAAAHHHHHHH!! I WAS\nSO LONELY!!
Huh? What? What's happening\nall of a sudden?!
WAAAAAAHHHHHHH!\nWAAAAAAHHHHHHH!!
What is it?! What's gotten into\nyou all of a sudden?!
Waaaaah!
In the Baschen of my era...\nthere is a people called the\nFoxtail.
The Foxtail?
I only learned that name\nrecently.
But I knew that such people\nexisted.
Those... those Foxtail people...
The Fox-Soul people...
I'm not sure if that's what they\nare.
But... in my era, Rubarika and\nBaschen are... peaceful.\nEveryone lives a normal life.
Normal... I see.
The Fox-Soul are a minority\nliving along the coast of\nBaschen.
Their power in Crest Arts is\noverwhelmingly stronger than\nordinary people...
But, well, they didn't exactly\nlive in a privileged environment.

Being used as decoys in wars,
or being sent to the front lines
of fierce battles where there's
no coming back...
That's... that's horrible.
Because for us, that was\nnormal.
Normal...!
But Lord Givel changed that\nenvironment for us...

Those with strong Crest power
were named "Beast Witches"...
and the status of the Fox Soul
people rose instantly.
Of course, it's not that we've\nforgotten what was done to us,\nor that we don't hold grudges...
But Lord Givel... he saved us...
...Karlyn...
Huh?
No, it's just... it's been a while\nsince someone called me that.
You see, I had a younger\nsister.
...You had?
During the Holy Land War. My\nvillage was burned by Rubarika.

Ever since then, I've lived only
to avenge my sister. That is
why I accepted Lord Givel's
invitation so readily...
To defeat Rubarika... I wanted\nto show... the power of the Fox\nSoul...
...My loyalty... was from the\nbottom of my heart...
I defeated the Rubarika\nsoldiers, and received Lord\nGivel's praise...
So I could... report back... to my\nsister's grave...
What is... this? What on earth\nhappened? I don't understand...
Whatever could have happened\nto Lord Givel...
Karlyn...
...Forgive me, I lost my\ncomposure.
I-I shouldn't say this, but you\nwere really quite a mess.
But I was truly lonely.
I... I see...
This Daft Double Planet\nExploration was my very first\nmission as Morphus.
If that's how you ended up\nstranded... well, it must have\nbeen hard.
Yes.
Just "yes"?
...I knew immediately when the\nCaptain's ship arrived at\nDaftine.

It was so painful being unable
to communicate even though I
could see them; I cried so
many times.
...Captain...
H-Hey!? Why are you getting\nso clingy with the Captain!!

I'm making sure this isn't a
dream. That this warmth and
these human genes aren't just
an electronic dream caused by
my sensor errors...

Even so, there's no need to be
that clingy! We have a small
child here, so don't do anything
inappropriate!
...I don't want to let go.
You seem to have quite a bit\nof energy left, don't you...?
You only treat me like a child\nwhen it's convenient for you.

Ah... Valka. I hate to be a wet
blanket, but... you do realize
that we are also in a state of
distress, don't you?

Of course, Dr. Belda. But as
long as you doctors are here,
there are countermeasures we
can take.
Eh?

There is a location nearby that
may contain parts capable of
constructing a long-range
communication device.
...What was that?
About 30 kilometers south of\nhere, there are traces of an\nabandoned city.
An abandoned city!? Is that\ntrue!?

These are ancient cities that
perished for unknown reasons.
Their scientific potential once
rivaled even our modern
advanced civilizations.
I thought there were no traces\nof humanity left in Daftes?

Even in Tika's era, it was so
unfit for human survival that it
was never chosen for
migration, despite being this
close...
That should be the case, but...
There are many situations that\nI simply cannot handle on my\nown, no matter how hard I try.
But... if I'm with everyone...!

<font color=blue>Verda</font> Still, if traces of
humanity truly exist, I wonder
why it wasn't a migration
destination during Tika's era.
<font color=blue>Tika</font> I don't know... Maybe it's\njust something I haven't been\ntaught in school yet.
Rekoro, do you know anything?
<font color=blue>Rekoro</font> I suspect it was not the\ntype of information registered\nin the life pod AI...
However, there is one factor I\ncan propose for consideration.
<font color=blue>Verda</font> And what might that\nbe?

<font color=blue>Rekoro</font> Daftes is not registered
as an emergency warp
destination or evacuation site
for the life pods.

<font color=blue>Verda</font> That's strange. Any
location should work for a life
pod's evacuation, provided the
atmosphere and water are
suitable.

<font color=blue>Valka</font> I suspect they wouldn't
go out of their way to the twin
stars if they were just seeking
an evacuation site near the
home planet.
<font color=blue>Verda</font> I wonder if we will find\nany new information once we\nreach those ruined cities...
What are those weirdly colored\nrocks... They're amazing.

Whoa... I wonder what that tree
is. How does it even grow in
that shape? I wonder if we
could use it for something...
...It looks like you've fully\nrecovered, Welch.
Hmm? I'm doing great!
I mean, sure, things were\npretty rough back in Korurine.

But how can I not get excited
when I'm facing an incredible
world full of brand-new things
like this!
Besides, I haven't even begun\nto investigate Valka's\nbelongings yet!
If anything, my energy is only\ngoing to double from here!
Lady Welch, you possess a\npersonality filled with curiosity.
Filled?!
Tsk, tsk, tsk! I *am* curiosity!\nCuriosity is me! I am curiosity!

Come on, world! Show this
genius beautiful girl,
Welch-chan, everything you've
got!!
...Well, I suppose it's better\nthan her being depressed...

And think, Eu! The "Ruined
Capital" ahead might hold the
"Servant of Daftes" or the
"Servant's Power"!

You're right, of course. Both
the "Emissaries" and their
"Powers" are said to originate
from Daftes!
Now, Valka was crying her eyes\nout, so I'm not sure how soon\nwe'll find anyone, but...

As long as we're walking
through this unknown world, we
don't have a single second to
waste moping around!
Before falling into confusion,\nthere are things to see and\nthings to think about.
Welch's "positivity" is indeed\nthe real deal!
You're right. I suppose I should\nfollow Welch's lead.
Yeah, actually...
I'm more concerned about her.
No, I don't think she's going to\ndo anything to us at this stage.
It's just... unlike us, she was\nbetrayed by her own homeland,\nwasn't she?
I just hope she doesn't act out\nin desperation...
Euwin, are you alright?
Me?
I mean, I'm certainly still in\nshock, but if you're asking if I'm\ndevastated, not really.
When you're traveling alone,\nlosing your composure can lead\ndirectly to death,

so I can't afford to stay
stunned. If anything, I'd rather
accept this situation with more
composure...
Hey Tika, how's the Arms\ndoing?
I only borrowed a little bit from\nValka's place, but I think it\nturned out pretty well.
Yeah. It still creaks a little, but\nit moves normally. Even Rekoro\nis surprised.
Thanks, Welch.

...To think that the repairs by
Welch Vineyard would actually
be effective... I have mixed
feelings.
You're such a stubborn little\nrice ball.
R-Rice ball!?
I have told you many times... I\nam RESCUE-AI-056, commonly\nknown as Rekoro...!
Yeah, yeah. I get it, I get it.

Lady Welch's talent can no
longer be contained within the
framework of Daftine. It is,
quite simply, worthy of
admiration.

Did you hear that, Rice
Ball-chan!? When you witness a
genius, this is how you praise
them sincerely!
Grrr...!
...I wish I could accept every\nsituation as smoothly as she\ndoes.
Euwin...

That aside, we can't let our
guard down. We mustn't forget
the group that attacked us
when we arrived here.

We've walked quite a distance
from Valka's ship, but the
surroundings are gradually
changing.
Perhaps...
Wha―!?
Hey, what are you suddenly...
Get down!!
Kyaah!?
Whoa!?
An enemy attack!?
There's no reaction on the\nsensors...!

For a group that supposedly
came from beyond the sky,
you're certainly slow to notice
this bizarre stench!
Looks like we managed to take\nit down.
My apologies, Lady Carlin. This\nsituation was caused by my\nown carelessness.
...Ugh, that gave me a scare.
(...As I thought, it won't\nactivate... and besides...)
Eh?

Even so, this thing really is the
same type of monster as the
werewolf-type "Baschen Beast,"
isn't it?

The other creatures are also
the same type as the
Thornites we saw in Daftine.
There is no mistake.
...Hey, Karlyn. Can I ask you\nsomething?

Even if you ask me why the
"Beasts" I summon look the
same as the creatures in this
land, I wouldn't know.
So you had noticed.

Of course. If that talk about
the Uchu earlier is true, they
might have been calling them
from this Daftes.
Even I can imagine that much.
Then, can't you do something\nlike control them so they don't\nattack us?
